title: Mailbox
readOnlyHint: Read here; reply, send and delete in IONOS webmail. Opened mail counts as read in IONOS too.
notConnectedHint: An admin sets up your IONOS mailbox.
authFailedHint: An admin needs to store the password again.

admin.title: Manage mailboxes
admin.hint: Admins store address and password centrally. Everyone only sees their own mailbox — admins can't read anyone else's here either.
admin.dialogHint: The login is checked with IONOS when you save. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin.rejected: IONOS rejected the address or password.
admin.removeBody: The stored password is deleted. The IONOS mailbox itself stays unchanged.
